results.releaseNotes:
What's New

- Weight logging with charts to track your progress over time
- New Body Profile for managing your height, weight, and activity level in one place
- Calibrated Energy: personalized energy targets based on your logged food and weight trend
- Easier macro goals using percentage splits or grams per body weight
- Simpler goal setup for setting a target and staying within a custom range
- Redesigned settings screens
- Customizable profile avatars for your Foodnoms account
- Share a text summary of your day's nutrition

Bug Fixes

- Fixed deleted items occasionally reappearing when syncing across devices
- Fixed incorrect dates on devices using the Buddhist calendar
- Fixed daily nutrition totals in Apple Health sometimes adding up to less than your logged food entries
- Fixed Apple Health data from other apps sometimes not importing until manually re-imported
- Fixed some nutrients missing when importing foods from Apple Health
- Improved reliability of logging favorites from Apple Watch
- Fixed Insights not refreshing when a new day starts
- Fixed widget buttons sometimes not responding when the app isn't running
- Fixed settings changes occasionally not saving
- Fixed adding a password to your account sometimes failing silently
- Fixed the Foodnoms AI input field being hidden behind the keyboard
- Improved sync error reporting with clearer guidance when sync can't proceed
- Fixed several rare crashes
- Various performance improvements and minor bug fixes
results.description:
Foodnoms is the nutrition tracker that respects your time and your privacy. Log meals in seconds, set goals that fit the way you eat, and watch your progress add up. No ads, no spam.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Log what you eat and drink in seconds: snap a photo, describe it in plain language, scan a barcode or nutrition label, or search a database of hundreds of thousands of foods.
2. Set custom goals for calories, macros, water, fiber, net carbs, vitamins, minerals, and dozens more.
3. Learn about your nutrition, and use that knowledge to reach your health and fitness goals.

FAST LOGGING
• Log an entire meal from a photo or a quick description with Foodnoms AI
• Scan barcodes and nutrition labels
• Save time with Smart Suggestions, which recommends foods based on your logging habits
• Log by voice, with Siri, or with dozens of actions in the Shortcuts app
• Leave the food scale at home: log estimates and tag how accurate they are

LEARN ABOUT YOUR NUTRITION
• See your progress on every goal over time
• Track your weight with trends and moving averages
• Discover which foods are helping you and which ones are holding you back with Top Foods
• Build a logging streak and share your milestones
• Automatic tracking of intermittent fasts

CALIBRATED ENERGY
• Calibrate your calorie goal using your own logged food and weight trend
• Get a calorie target grounded in your real results, not just a formula

QUICK ACCESS EVERYWHERE
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets for goals, macros, streaks, water, and quick logging
• Control Center controls to jump straight to the scanner or Foodnoms AI
• Log favorites from your wrist with the Apple Watch app and complications

WORKS WITH APPLE HEALTH
• Read and write nutrition data to the Health app: calories, macros, vitamins, minerals, water, caffeine, and more
• Keep your weight and height in sync, including weigh-ins from a smart scale
• Use Active Energy from the Health app (your Apple Watch Move ring) to automatically adjust your calorie goal

WORKS ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
• Available for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch
• Sync securely with your choice of Foodnoms Cloud or iCloud

BUILT TO PROTECT YOUR PRIVACY
• Your data belongs to you: export your food log to CSV or request a full account export anytime
• Transparent privacy policy

TRUSTWORTHY NUTRITION DATA
• A database of hundreds of thousands of foods with rich nutrition data from trustworthy sources
• Scan nutrition labels to log accurate data for packaged foods
• Create custom foods, recipes, and meals, and share them with friends

FOR EVERYONE
• Dynamic Type, Dark Mode, and VoiceOver support
• Metric and imperial units, including kilojoules

FOODNOMS+ VS FREE
• Free: unlimited food tracking; barcode scanning; goals for calories and macros; recipes and meals; Apple Health export; reminders; CSV export
• Foodnoms+: Foodnoms AI photo and text logging; Calibrated Energy; track water, sodium, fiber, net carbs, caffeine, alcohol, vitamins, and minerals; recipe import from the web; custom meal types and timestamps; favorites; Apple Health import; weekly and monthly charts; Top Foods analysis; one-day goal exceptions; alternate app icons; plus other exclusive features

Privacy Policy: https://foodnoms.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://foodnoms.com/terms

advisories: Infrequent/Mild Alcohol, Tobacco, or Drug Use or References

Track calories, macros, fasting, and 95+ vitamins and minerals with one of the most trusted health and fitness apps available. 

Whether you're using Cronometer as a weight loss tracker, macro tracker or overall metabolic health tracker, you'll get clear, reliable science-backed insights into your nutrition and how it supports your goals. 

Unlike basic calorie counters, Cronometer is built on a curated database of more than 1.1 million verified foods, including analyzed entries for unmatched accuracy. Get precise nutrition tracking, comprehensive nutrient analysis, and reliable nutrition facts you can trust. 

Gain deeper nutrition insights with precision nutrition tools trusted by dietitians, healthcare professionals, and athletes worldwide. 



Track your nutrition with confidence 

• Log meals in a detailed food diary 
• Track calories, protein, carbs, fat, fiber, vitamins, and minerals 
• Monitor both macronutrients and micronutrients 
• Compare your intake against personalized nutrition targets 

Perfect for weight loss, muscle gain, and improving overall health. 

 

A smarter weight tracker 

• Track calories and weight loss (or gain) with deeper nutritional context

• Built for sustainable weight loss, healthy weight management, and long-term success 

 

Build healthier habits

Connect fitness, sleep, and health

Four easy ways to log food

Why Cronometer? 

Cronometer is the calorie tracker and food diary trusted by dietitians, athletes, and health professionals worldwide. 
It’s been featured in Healthline, Prevention, Women’s Health, Good Housekeeping, Men’s Health, CNET, Oprah and more. 

 
Upgrade to Cronometer Gold

Photo & Voice Logging 

Fasting Tracker

Deeper insights 

More options to customize 

Ad-free experience
